annotation.interpretation_a: Expert reviewers are permitted to reject registrations that conflict with HTTP/2 settings, but are not required to.
annotation.interpretation_b: Expert reviewers are obligated to reject registrations that conflict with HTTP/2 settings, but have discretion about whether to do so.
annotation.justification: The use of "MAY" creates ambiguity as to whether rejection is optional or required when a conflict exists. The clause does not clearly state the level of obligation on the expert reviewers.
